# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** 6  <sub>[v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P18](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0018), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Dora](../character/dora.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Davy is a handsome child with a round head covered in fuzzy, curly yellow ringlets. He has a distinct snub nose and a single dimple in one cheek.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Davy is a practical boy who completely lacks imagination, often becoming puzzled or disgusted by things he cannot logically grasp. He possesses a lively curiosity and an inquisitive nature, frequently asking endless questions that stem from a strong thirst for information. Full of mischief, heedless, and disobedient, he often engages in forbidden behavior and exhibits a distinctly naughty side, though he is impatient of punishment that forces him to miss out on the fun. Despite his troublesome antics and forgetfulness, he shows consideration for the feelings of others and possesses a natural knack for winning love. Driven by his desires, he aspires to become a storekeeper who keeps abundant supplies of candy and bananas.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P55](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0055), [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), +8 more_

## History

Davy Keith arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as an orphan alongside his well-behaved twin sister, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and quickly established a reputation for causing chaos through disruptive pranks. His early antics included tricking [Dora](../character/dora.md) into a pigpen, placing a toad in Marilla's bed, and locking [Dora](../character/dora.md) inside a toolhouse, though he eventually broke down in remorse when confronted by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Davy formed a close bond with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who regularly corrected his funny theological misunderstandings, comforted his occasional jealousy, and guided him through bedtime prayers. Despite continuing to cause minor mishaps, such as accidentally ruining lemon pies prepared for a guest and misbehaving at table and in school, he was openly preferred by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) over his sister due to his lively nature. When the twins' uncle passed away, he left behind a trust fund that officially secured Davy's permanent home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P4](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0004), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P7](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0007), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), +499 more_

## Quotes

> "You don’t look like a lady who’d whip a little boy just ’cause he couldn’t keep still. Didn’t you find it awful hard to keep still when you was only ‘s old as me?"
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003)

> "You was a girl once, I s’pose, though it’s awful funny to think of it. Dora can sit still . . . but there ain’t much fun in it I don’t think. Seems to me it must be slow to be a girl. Here, Dora, let me liven you up a bit."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)

> "Marilla washed it yesterday . . . and Mrs. Wiggins scoured me with hard soap the day of the funeral. That’s enough for one week. I don’t see the good of being so awful clean. It’s lots more comfable being dirty."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P31](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0031)

> "But it was such a jolly big caterpillar . . . I picked him up on the church steps just as we went in. It seemed a pity to waste him. And say, wasn’t it fun to hear that girl yell?"
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P43](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0043)

> “I . . . did something else today,” went on Davy in a muffled voice. “I’m sorry now but I’m awful scared to tell you. You won’t be very cross, will you? And you won’t tell Marilla, will you?”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--davy-keith.md)

Davy is Anne's student and lives under her care at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where he frequently confides his misdeeds to her and relies on her kindness to save food for him. Despite his disruptive pranks, falsehoods, and misbehavior at home and in school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) patiently lectures him on morality, manages his mischievous antics, and reassures him of her affection.

- Friend of — relies on her kindness to save food for him  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P55](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0055), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P34](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0034), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)</sub>
- Student of — pupil in her school class  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Dora](../character/dora.md) is Davy's twin sister, who contrasts sharply with him through her quiet, well-behaved nature. Davy frequently targets her with tricks and pranks, such as tricking her into falling into a pigpen, attempting to spray her with a water pump, and locking her inside a toolhouse.

- Sibling of — twin brother and sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +7 more</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--paul-irving.md)

Davy harbors a unilateral resentment toward [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), feeling jealous of Anne's attention and fond regard for him. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea, Davy requires her reassurance regarding her affection for him during his bedtime prayers to soothe his jealousy.

- Rival of — unilateral resentment and comparison  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033)</sub>
